parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: The list of rule IDs to delete.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the user information to delete. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: ServiceCode
parameters.description: The service code of the ID Verification product. Set the value to **antcloudauth**.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor. CIDR format and IPv4 format are supported. Example: 10.0.3.0/24.
